what_it_is.prose: ISRO describes NavIC as an independent regional navigation system covering India and about 1,500 km beyond the landmass, with a seven-satellite baseline and NVS modernization. NVS-02 reached GTO but could not complete orbit raising because oxidizer valves did not open.
